notes.title: Drox Operative 2 patch 0.801
notes.notes:
This patch makes radar much more useful, simplifies race statements, fixes federations, decreases scanning times, protects low level systems more, describes some of the newer systems better, balances a bunch of things better, and fixes a ton of other more minor issues.

0.801 change list:

[list]
    [*]made radar much more useful by increasing MaxRadarRange from 300.0 to 1000.0
    [*]now an undiscovered planet in radar range will show on the edge of your minimap
    [*]now all planets in radar range will show up on system map
    [*]planets and gates now have a radar bonus so it's easier to find them
    [*]added Simplify Race Statements option, defaults to on, basically simple race statements go directly to event messages instead of needing player to go to the race screen
    [*]fixed federation always voting no on peace even when they wanted it (Sharp)
    [*]fixed another federation voting issue basically making it need to be unanimous
    [*]races in federation are now allowed to cancel treaties (Sharp)
    [*]greatly increased identifing components time (4x faster)
    [*]increased scanning chest/objects time (2x faster)
    [*]increased ItemIdentifyExtraModifierChance from 0.05 to 0.1
    [*]asteroids system modifier now has a minimum level of 10 (ScrObot)
    [*]illusions system modifier now has a minimum level of 10 (ScrObot)
    [*]added descriptions to Vassal, Tributary, and Protectorates on trade screen (ScrObot)
    [*]increased beam damage by 50% since the damage now decreases by distance quite a bit
    [*]components no longer compare to empty slots (so don't get green + on everything)
    [*]ancients are initially a little less aggressive towards the player
    [*]decreased TributaryMaxPowerRatio from 0.85 to 0.5 (Bluddy)
    [*]decreased VassalMaxPowerRatio from 0.75 to 0.4 (Bluddy)
    [*]decreased VassalFearMult and TributaryFearMult from 0.5 to 0.3 (Bluddy)
    [*]now ships around planets will fly back to their planet instead of teleporting (They Live)
    [*]now get a message if a peace trety was rejected by a federation (kouhei)
    [*]increased starting MaxPowerLoad by 33% (75 to 100)
    [*]now race specific components auto equip into the correct slots
    [*]now on level up you can be given any of your race specific components (not just crew) (KevinC)
    [*]primitives are no longer consider for diplomatic and military wins or losses
    [*]now if you sign a peace treay with one federation member the rest will follow (they already voted to allow it)
    [*]alliances and federations tend to get stronger over time now
    [*]decreased ancients NaturalHateMult from 3.0 to 2.0 (their relations will degrade slower)
    [*]decreased ObjectChancePerBlock from 0.06 to 0.045
    [*]changed priority level on most quests (Sharp)
    [*]no longer get a chest for each primitive race in fear & diplomatic wins
    [*]fixed numbers on offensive and defensive rams displayed incorrectly (they are     addition/subtraction, not a % chance)
    [*]fixed defensive numbers on rams not showing up
    [*]now rams actually have a credit value
    [*]gates now always send across the network when you are in the same system
    [*]increased RadarForMaxRangeBase from 300.0 to 400.0
    [*]now planet sub-screens will go away when you click outside of them (ScrObot)
    [*]drones can be put into stashes now
    [*]tab now toggles between system & sector map and doesn't change minimap, also setting now saves correctly (Bluddy)
    [*]planets now spin slower (ScrObot)
    [*]added show trades option on relation screen
    [*]relation screen now defaults to hiding eliminated races (one time force change)
    [*]relation screen now defaults to hiding primitives races (one time force change) (Eris Shrugged)
    [*]moved event text up a little to not go over status effects
    [*]made it so you can't get multiple war sounds at once (Darkness)
    [*]now handle removing a shield correctly (Excellion)
    [*]now highlight text box will be at least the size of the icon (if there is an icon) (ScrObot)
    [*]turned general pleas for help off for now
    [*]now clean up unidentified stuff a little better on primitive planets when they change state (Bluddy/Dragonface)
    [*]added QuestChildQuests and NoChildQuestsOutstanding translations (Dragonface)
    [*]fixed credits pickup text (They Live)
    [*]fixed getting multiple object is farther than it appears messages sometimes

[/list]
